fullName: Matilda of Flanders, Queen of England
fullNameCn: 佛兰德的玛蒂尔达，英格兰王后
notes: Wife of William the Conqueror. Birth year is approximate. Served as regent of Normandy during William's absences in England (c. 1066-1072); also called Maud.

deathCause.detail: Matilda died in Normandy on 2 November 1083. Standard accounts do not describe a violent or suspicious death.
deathCause.detailCn: 1083年11月2日玛蒂尔达在诺曼底去世。通行史料未记载暴力或可疑的死因。

events.label: Marriage to William, Duke of Normandy
events.labelCn: 与诺曼底公爵威廉成婚

events.label: Birth of Adeliza of Normandy
events.labelCn: 诺曼底的阿德莉扎出生

events.label: Birth of Cecilia of Normandy
events.labelCn: 诺曼底的塞西莉亚出生

events.label: Birth of Matilda of Normandy
events.labelCn: 诺曼底的玛蒂尔达出生

events.label: Birth of Constance of Normandy
events.labelCn: 诺曼底的康斯坦丝出生

events.label: Death of Matilda of Flanders
events.labelCn: 佛兰德的玛蒂尔达去世

fullName: Isabella of Hainaut, Queen of France
fullNameCn: 法兰西王后埃诺的伊莎贝尔
notes: First wife of Philippe II Augustus. Parents (Baldwin V of Hainaut and Margaret I of Flanders) are not yet in the roster.

deathCause.detail: Isabella gave birth to twin sons on 14 March 1190 (both died within days) and died the next day, 15 March 1190, aged 19. She was buried in Notre-Dame de Paris.
deathCause.detailCn: 1190 年 3 月 14 日伊莎贝尔产下一对双胞胎儿子（数日内先后夭折），次日（3 月 15 日）去世，年仅 19 岁，葬于巴黎圣母院。

events.label: Marriage to Philippe II at Bapaume
events.labelCn: 在巴波姆与腓力二世成婚
events.note: Her dowry was the county of Artois; both bride and groom were fifteen.

events.label: Coronation as Queen of France
events.note: Crowned at Saint-Denis.

events.label: Birth of twin sons Robert and Philippe
events.labelCn: 诞下双胞胎罗伯特与菲利普
events.note: Robert died the same day and Philippe three days later; both are excluded from the roster as infants who died young.

events.label: Died in Paris following childbirth
events.note: Philippe II was away campaigning in Normandy and did not attend the funeral.

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的鲍德温一世
notes: Rose to prominence through his marriage to Judith, daughter of Charles the Bald; the Flemish margraviate later developed into the County of Flanders.

events.label: Eloped with Judith of the Carolingians
events.labelCn: 与加洛林公主朱迪丝私奔
events.note: Baldwin abducted or eloped with Judith, daughter of Charles the Bald, drawing excommunication before a reconciliation.

events.label: Created Margrave of Flanders
events.note: After reconciling with Charles the Bald, Baldwin was confirmed as margrave of the Flemish march, the nucleus of the later County of Flanders.

events.label: Fortified Flanders against Viking raids
events.labelCn: 加固佛兰德抵御维京人
events.note: Throughout his rule Baldwin fortified and defended the Flemish coast and riverlands against Norse raiders.

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的鲍德温二世
notes: Son of Baldwin I and Judith; his marriage to Ælfthryth linked the Flemish and West Saxon dynasties.

events.label: Succeeded as Count of Flanders
events.note: Succeeded his father Baldwin I as ruler of the Flemish march.

events.label: Married Ælfthryth of Wessex
events.labelCn: 迎娶威塞克斯的埃尔芙斯丽丝
events.note: Married Ælfthryth, daughter of Alfred the Great, binding the Flemish and West Saxon dynasties.

events.label: Had Archbishop Fulk the Venerable murdered
events.labelCn: 派人刺杀兰斯大主教富尔克
events.note: Fulk, Archbishop of Reims, had excommunicated Baldwin; Baldwin had him assassinated in 900, provoking widespread scandal.

fullNameCn: 康布雷的拉乌尔
notes: Younger son of Baldwin I and Judith; his later career is recorded separately from the main Flemish succession.

events.label: Installed as Count of Cambrai
events.note: Made count and lay abbot of Cambrai around 888, in the context of his brother Baldwin II's support for King Odo.

events.label: Campaign against Vermandois
events.note: Supporting his brother Baldwin II, Ralph captured Arras, Saint-Quentin and Péronne before King Odo drove his forces out.

events.label: Captured and killed by Herbert I of Vermandois
events.labelCn: 被韦尔芒杜瓦伯爵赫伯特一世所杀
events.note: Taken prisoner by Herbert I of Vermandois and put to death in June 896.

displayNameCn: 佛兰德的阿努尔夫一世
fullNameCn: 佛兰德的阿努尔夫一世
notes: Succeeded Baldwin II and consolidated the Flemish county amid conflict with neighbouring powers.

events.label: Succeeded as Count of Flanders
events.note: Succeeded his father Baldwin II and consolidated the Flemish county.

events.label: Married Adela of Vermandois
events.labelCn: 迎娶韦尔芒杜瓦的阿黛拉
events.note: Married Adela, daughter of Herbert II of Vermandois, as part of his southward expansion.

events.label: Complicit in the murder of William Longsword
events.labelCn: 参与谋杀诺曼底公爵长剑威廉
events.note: Arnulf arranged the ambush and killing of William Longsword, Duke of Normandy, on an island in the Somme in December 942.

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的鲍德温三世
notes: Ruled jointly with his father Arnulf I; the succession returned to his father after his early death.

events.label: Made co-ruler of Flanders
events.note: His father Arnulf I made him joint count of Flanders in 958.

events.label: Married Matilda of Saxony
events.labelCn: 迎娶萨克森的玛蒂尔达
events.note: Married Matilda, daughter of Duke Hermann Billung of Saxony; their son was Arnulf II.

events.label: Died young, returning power to Arnulf I
events.labelCn: 英年早逝，权力回到阿努尔夫一世
events.note: His early death returned the county to his father Arnulf I, who then arranged for his grandson Arnulf II to succeed.

displayNameCn: 佛兰德的阿努尔夫二世
fullNameCn: 佛兰德的阿努尔夫二世
notes: Son of Baldwin III and successor to the Flemish county.

events.label: Succeeded as Count of Flanders
events.note: Succeeded his grandfather Arnulf I as a minor, with the county briefly under a regency.

events.label: Married Rozala of Italy
events.note: Married Rozala (Susanna) of Ivrea, daughter of Berengar II of Italy; the year is disputed (968 or 976).

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的鲍德温四世
notes: Known as Baldwin the Bearded; father of Baldwin V by Ogive of Luxembourg and of Judith by Eleanor of Normandy.

events.label: Succeeded as Count of Flanders
events.note: Succeeded his father Arnulf II as a minor.

events.label: Married Ogive of Luxembourg
events.note: His first marriage, to Ogive of Luxembourg, produced his heir Baldwin V; the year is approximate.

events.label: Married Eleanor of Normandy
events.note: His second marriage, to Eleanor, daughter of Duke Richard II, aligned Flanders with Normandy.

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的鲍德温五世
notes: Father of Matilda of Flanders, who married William the Conqueror; also father of Baldwin VI and Robert I.

events.label: Married Adela of France
events.note: Married Adela, daughter of King Robert II of France, tying the Flemish counts to the Capetian house.

events.label: Succeeded as Count of Flanders
events.note: Succeeded his father Baldwin IV as Count of Flanders.

events.label: Became regent of France
events.note: After Henry I's death in 1060, Baldwin acted as regent for his young nephew-by-marriage Philip I until 1066–67.

fullNameCn: 法兰德伯爵夫人法兰西的阿黛拉
notes: Daughter of Robert II of France and wife of Baldwin V; mother of Matilda of Flanders.

events.label: Married Baldwin V of Flanders
events.labelCn: 嫁给佛兰德的鲍德温五世
events.note: Married Baldwin V of Flanders; their daughter Matilda later married William the Conqueror.

events.label: Pilgrimage to Rome
events.note: After Baldwin V's death she made a pilgrimage to Rome, where Pope Alexander II gave her the veil.

events.label: Retired to Messines and took the veil
events.labelCn: 隐退梅西讷并成为修女
events.note: After her Roman pilgrimage she retired to the Benedictine community she had founded at Messines (Mesen), where she died in 1079.

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的鲍德温六世
notes: Matilda of Flanders's brother; succeeded their father as Count of Flanders.

events.label: Married Richilde of Hainaut
events.note: Through Richilde he became co-ruler (jure uxoris) of Hainaut.

events.label: Succeeded as Count of Flanders
events.note: Inherited the county on the death of his father Baldwin V.

events.label: Death
events.note: His death opened a succession struggle between his widow Richilde and his brother Robert the Frisian.

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的罗贝尔一世
notes: Matilda of Flanders's brother; became Count of Flanders after the succession crisis of 1071.

events.label: Battle of Cassel
events.note: Defeated Richilde and his nephew Arnulf III, who was killed, winning Flanders.

events.label: Pilgrimage to Jerusalem
events.note: Made a pilgrimage to the Holy Land (c. 1085–1091); on his return he aided the Byzantine emperor.

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的罗贝尔二世
notes: Succeeded his father Robert I and joined the First Crusade.

events.label: Joined the First Crusade
events.labelCn: 参加第一次十字军东征
events.note: Fought at the Siege of Antioch (1098) and the capture of Jerusalem (1099).

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的鲍德温七世
notes: Succeeded Robert II and died without a surviving heir.

events.label: Battle of Bures-en-Bray
events.note: Fought Henry I of England on behalf of Louis VI of France and was wounded.

events.label: Death from wounds
events.note: Died of his wounds, naming his cousin Charles the Good as heir.

fullNameCn: 威廉·克利顿，佛兰德伯爵
notes: Son of Robert Curthose; installed with French support after Charles the Good's death, but faced a competing Flemish succession.

events.label: Installed as Count of Flanders
events.note: Placed in Flanders by Louis VI of France after the assassination of Charles the Good.

events.label: Flemish towns revolt
events.note: Faced a rising led by the Flemish towns in favour of Thierry of Alsace.

events.label: Death at Aalst
events.note: Died of a wound received while besieging Aalst.

fullNameCn: 佛兰德的阿德拉，丹麦王后
notes: Daughter of Robert I, Count of Flanders, and wife of Canute IV of Denmark.

events.label: Married Canute IV of Denmark
events.labelCn: 嫁给丹麦国王克努特四世
events.note: Became Queen consort of Denmark.

events.label: Fled Denmark with her son Charles
events.note: Fled to Flanders after her husband's murder, leaving her daughters behind.

events.label: Married Roger Borsa, Duke of Apulia
events.labelCn: 改嫁阿普利亚公爵罗杰·博尔萨
events.note: Left Flanders for Italy; later acted as regent of Apulia (1111–1114).

fullName: Baldwin V of Hainaut, Baldwin VIII of Flanders
fullNameCn: 埃诺伯爵鲍德温五世、佛兰德伯爵鲍德温八世

events.label: Became Count of Flanders jure uxoris
events.labelCn: 以妻权成为佛兰德伯爵

sourceNote: Gislebert of Mons, Chronicle of Hainaut; British Museum Collections Online entry for Baldwin VIII; Diplomatica Belgica.
notes: His marriage to Margaret I reunited the ruling families of Hainaut and Flanders. He was the father of Isabella of Hainaut, queen of Philip II of France, and of Baldwin VI of Hainaut/Baldwin IX of Flanders. As Count of Flanders he ruled jure uxoris from 1191. Margaret died in 1194 and their son Baldwin IX inherited Flanders; some catalogues nevertheless extend Baldwin VIII's Flemish chronology into 1195, so 1191–1194 is used here for the dynastic succession.

fullName: Baldwin VI of Hainaut, Baldwin IX of Flanders, Latin Emperor Baldwin I
fullNameCn: 埃诺伯爵鲍德温六世、佛兰德伯爵鲍德温九世、拉丁皇帝鲍德温一世

events.label: Became Latin Emperor of Constantinople
events.labelCn: 成为君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝

sourceNote: British Museum Collections Online, Baldwin I of Constantinople; Encyclopaedia Britannica; New Cambridge Medieval History and modern Fourth Crusade scholarship.
notes: Baldwin inherited Flanders in 1194 and Hainaut in 1195. After leading the Fourth Crusade he became the first Latin emperor of Constantinople; his daughters Joan and Margaret inherited his western counties. Do not confuse him with the project's existing 11th-century Baldwin VI of Flanders, husband of Richilde, who was Baldwin I of Hainaut. Baldwin VI/IX's birth is variously dated 1171 or 1172. He was captured after the Battle of Adrianople in 1205; the precise date and circumstances of his death are uncertain and some sources place it in 1206.

fullName: Joan of Constantinople, Countess of Flanders and Hainaut
fullNameCn: 君士坦丁堡的让娜，佛兰德与埃诺女伯爵
deathPlaceCn: 里尔附近马凯特修道院
sourceNote: Columbia University Epistolae, Joan of Constantinople; Erin L. Jordan, 'Female Founders'; New Cambridge Medieval History.
notes: Joan inherited Flanders and Hainaut as a child after her father's disappearance and ruled until 1244. She left no surviving heir, so both counties passed to her younger sister Margaret. Her birth is generally given as 1199 or 1200; 1200 is retained to match the requested project chronology.

fullName: Margaret II of Flanders, Countess of Flanders and Hainaut
displayNameCn: 佛兰德的玛格丽特二世
fullNameCn: 佛兰德女伯爵玛格丽特二世、埃诺女伯爵玛格丽特一世

events.label: Hainaut awarded to the Avesnes line

sourceNote: Larousse, Marguerite II de Constantinople; Columbia University Epistolae; Karen Nicholas on ruling countesses in medieval Flanders.
notes: Margaret inherited both counties in 1244. The succession struggle between her Avesnes sons from her first marriage and Dampierre sons from her second ultimately separated the inheritance: Hainaut passed through the Avesnes line, while Flanders passed to the Dampierres. The Avesnes transition was not a simple father-to-son succession in 1244. Louis IX's arbitration in 1246 assigned future rights in Hainaut to the Avesnes line; Margaret nevertheless remained an important holder/ruler of Hainaut until 1280, with periods of contested authority in the 1250s. Sources differ over her precise birthplace and death place, with Valenciennes/Bruges and Ghent/Lille variants.
